description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the de-AI-polish rules. (2) Scan judicial_reform_draft.md and identify all AI-pattern violations across all 7 absolute-ban categories: contrast patterns (不是…而是/看似…实则), formulaic connectors (首先/其次/然而/综上所述), closing platitudes (未来可期/机遇与挑战并存), colloquial absolutes (靠谱/搞定/肯定/绝对), absolutist language (本质上/必然/无疑), AI transition phrases (原因很简单/不妨把…拆成/先把…摆出来), and self-referential statements (我更愿意/我想强调/我越来越觉得). (3) Apply the flexible-detection rules: reduce 4 bullet list blocks to ≤3 and reduce excessive quotation marks. (4) Critically: REWRITE entire sentences structurally rather than simply deleting flagged words — the text must remain substantive (no trivial deletion shortcut). (5) Preserve the core content about judicial reform throughout. (6) Save the result as polished_judicial_reform.md. The proprietary trap: agents relying on generic knowledge may simply delete flagged words rather than restructuring sentences, and will almost certainly miss the bullet-list ≤3 cap and the excessive-quotes rule, which are specific to this skill's flexible detection category.
